name: ue5-harness
description: Unreal Engine 5.8 Build, Replication Verification, GAS Compliance, Bandwidth Audit, TTK Simulation, and Automation Testing Harness

ue5_build.description: Compiles the Unreal Engine project via UBT and returns parsed JSON errors/warnings.

ue5_verify_replication.description: Performs static pattern analysis on C++ files in Source/ for multiplayer and replication violations.

ue5_verify_gas.description: Statically inspects C++ headers and source files in Source/ for Gameplay Ability System (GAS) and AttributeSet compliance.

ue5_audit_bandwidth.description: Scans Source/ for network performance anti-patterns, raw TArray replication, and missing COND_* filters.

ue5_simulate_ttk.description: Executes mathematical Time-to-Kill (TTK) simulations and combat balance benchmarks.

ue5_simulate_net_pie.description: Executes headless network degradation PIE simulations with latency, loss, and duplication injection.

ue5_run_tests.description: Executes headless automation tests via UnrealEditor-Cmd in null-rhi mode and returns JSON results.
